skills_versions: Prerequisites: Two to three years of operational experience working in a data center with NVIDIA hardware solutions. The candidate should be able to monitor and manage all the parts of a data center infrastructure in support of AI workloads.
Validity: This certification is valid for two years from issuance. Recertification may be achieved by retaking the exam.

This exam has two sections: a multiple-choice section and a performance-based test section (or hands-on lab). Each section is worth 50% of the overall score. The score of the two sections is combined for a total score resulting in a pass or fail. You will receive a score report indicating how you performed on each topic, and each section.

The performance-based test section includes three challenges. A short scenario describes a common problem for you to solve. You will be in a live virtual machine with an instruction panel providing you with the scenario and any resources you may need. To complete the performance-based test you will need to be comfortable using Slurm in BCM to troubleshoot a cluster, using Kubernetes to run a workload, and using BCM to add a node to a cluster.
